description: Executable Candidate Ray TP2 recipe for LibertAI's calibrated 181 GiB GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 multimodal checkpoint. It runs MiaAI-Lab's published image ghcr.io/miaai-lab/glm53-flash-spark:mm-ray-v1 (sha256:376f11dfd61abb06731d2d542b53c8c2954ffbcf1846ccd3af564d507ec5436f; her SM121 sparse-MLA kernel layer on a development vLLM build with a FlashInfer 0.6.18 nightly and NCCL 2.30.7, plus Ray 2.58.0) as the kit gives it, not rebuilt from the kit's sources, with a thin layer for the Controller's launcher, the multimodal chat template and the non-root user, and reproduces its 262K profile, FP8 KV cache, MTP4, and conservative 0.84 unified-memory budget; the calibrated per-projection input scales replace the underflowing 1.0 placeholders, and Vonk physical acceptance plus long-context repetition regression remain pending.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks
